/services/low-voltage-subcontractor-lubb.heading: What to send for a Lubbock proposal
/services/low-voltage-subcontractor-lubb.answer: Send the drawings or scope, quantities, site address and required date. Nova Titan manages delivery and assigns field resources for the approved project.
inputs: Identify cable type, drops, rack locations and who provides pathways and materials.
Confirm the occupied areas, work windows and local site-access contact.
Specify testing, labeling, as-builts and closeout requirements.
/services/low-voltage-subcontractor-lubb.boundary: Travel, specialty equipment, testing and changes are addressed in the proposal. A requested date becomes a commitment only after scope and field availability are confirmed.

/services/security-camera-infrastructure.heading: What to send for camera infrastructure pricing
/services/security-camera-infrastructure.answer: Send the camera-location drawing, device count, cable requirements and rack or NVR location so we can define the physical infrastructure scope.
inputs: Identify equipment models, PoE requirements, mounting heights and lift/access needs.
Confirm who supplies devices, mounts, switches and materials.
Identify the integrator responsible for system design, programming, monitoring and acceptance.
/services/security-camera-infrastructure.boundary: Regulated installation and specialty system work require the appropriate qualified or licensed party; those responsibilities are confirmed before award.

/services/fire-alarm-subcontractor-texas.heading: What is needed to scope Division 28 coordination?
/services/fire-alarm-subcontractor-texas.answer: Provide the current fire-alarm drawings, specification, device schedule and construction milestones so responsibilities can be established before pricing.
inputs: Name the fire-alarm contractor and identify the approved design and revision.
Separate pathway and rough-in coordination from regulated installation, programming, testing and tagging.
Identify material responsibility, site access, inspections and required closeout.
/services/fire-alarm-subcontractor-texas.boundary: Regulated fire-alarm work is assigned to properly licensed Texas partners. No system acceptance, programming or inspection date is promised before scope and resources are confirmed.
